recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reopen FHIR-2889 unless a separate concrete defect is found in generated schemas or examples; any broad Atom-replacement review belongs under FHIR-3728 or a new focused tracker, not this already-satisfied profile-metadata request.
issue_request: FHIR-2889 was a Published/Persuasive change request asking that metadata such as profile identifiers or tags be expressible and accessible in ordinary XML resource instances and resource-level schemas, without requiring a FHIR server, an extension, or the old full fhir.atom wrapper schema.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as done as part of FHIR-3728. FHIR-3728 was the Published/Persuasive Atom replacement issue, approved in November 2014, and its implementation commits removed Atom wrappers and added resource-level metadata infrastructure. Historical source at commit 80fbeea246 already contained Resource.meta metadata rows as part of that change family.
additional_context: The current build has Resource as an active resource-infrastructure entry and Meta as an active type in source/fhir.ini. Current Resource defines Resource.meta as a Meta element; current Meta defines Meta.profile as canonical(StructureDefinition); resource narrative explains profile assertions in Resource Metadata; and the XML representation page explicitly includes id, meta, implicitRules, and language as base Resource children before resource-specific elements. Quoted Jira-key Zulip searches and Confluence reference searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the current source already makes profile metadata a normal resource XML element, not Atom-only metadata, and duplicative prose would not change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-2889 says it was done as part of this Atom replacement issue, whose source change moved resource metadata into resources.
